notes: Single source of truth for PAI speech language aliasing and provider coverage.
alias -> canonical. Matching is ASCII case-insensitive; canonical form is returned verbatim.
Tags absent from aliases pass through unchanged (after case normalization) and are NEVER re-rooted to a region (fr stays fr).
auto is the reserved 'detect' sentinel used by speech manifests.

Provider coverage is TRUTHFUL capability, not aspiration: a provider may only claim a language here when local assets for it exist or are declared by the pack system. Qwen3-ASR covers Hindi but NOT Assamese; Assamese routes to IndicConformer.
whisper_cpp lists only the languages the shipped whisper-base.en English model actually supports; multilingual whisper requires a different model and explicit evidence before it is added here.
